forum.title: ARM-based PC - Cannot install STLINK drivers on Windows 11
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content: This is an ARM64 machine. It needs drivers specially updated for ARM. STSW-LINK009 download is for Intel.  Please contact ST support: <https://ols.st.com/s/>
forum.content_text:
